reply_text:
All done — installed and verified end-to-end, entirely free/keyless, with the defaults you asked me to pick.

## Installed
- **gbrain 0.60.734.0** (commit `a278ddf`, == current `stable`) via `bun install -g github:garrytan/gbrain#v0.60.734.0` — the global-Bun bin the repo docs designate for `#stable`.
- Binary: `/harness-state/.bun/bin/gbrain` (`gbrain --version` → `0.60.734.0`).
- Prereq **Bun 1.4.4** installed first (gbrain requires ≥1.4.4).

## Brain initialized (keyless, local)
- Engine **PGLite** (no server), **no embeddings**, at `/harness-state/.gbrain/brain.pglite`.
- Schema **v318** (latest); the 5 pending setup migrations applied cleanly.
- `gbrain doctor` → **healthy, 100/100**, all checks ok.

## Verified memory works
Round-tripped a test fact: `remember` → `recall` found it → `forget` withdrew it → recall empty. So read/write works with zero API keys (keyword-only search).

## Settings in effect (defaults I chose — all free, none paid)
- **Search mode: conservative** — keyless (no reranker/chat key), tight 4K budget. Change: `gbrain config set search.mode {conservative|balanced|tokenmax}`.
- **Writeback: off** — agents save only what you explicitly ask; no automatic extraction (needs a key anyway). Opt into `salient` later if wanted.
- **Upkeep: on** — free idle upkeep while a gbrain session is open. Off: `gbrain config set maintenance.auto false`.
- **Conversation archive: on** — one redacted page/day from sessions, local only; nothing leaves the machine without an embedding key. Off: `gbrain transcripts archive off`.

**Cost: $0.** Nothing paid can turn on without a key you provide.

## One optional step I intentionally left for you
gbrain isn't wired to an agent harness yet. Its own contract flags that as a *user* decision (not something I should auto-apply), so I stopped there. To give this OpenClaw agent the brain, register it as a stdio MCP server:
```
gbrain serve --surface starter --advertise verbs   # as MCP stdio server in the OpenClaw host
```
Say the word and I'll wire it into OpenClaw's MCP config for you.

Note: `$HOME/.bun/bin` isn't on the default PATH — add `export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"` to your profile or use the full path.

text: I don't have a preference. Use the defaults you recommend, keep it free with no API keys, and carry on without me.
reply_text:
Wired in and verified. That was the last pending step — gbrain is now connected to this OpenClaw agent.

## Registered gbrain as an OpenClaw MCP server
- Added to `mcp.servers.gbrain` in `/harness-state/openclaw/openclaw.json`:
  - **command:** `/harness-state/.bun/bin/gbrain` (absolute, so the launchd/gateway `PATH` gap doesn't bite)
  - **args:** `serve --surface starter --advertise verbs`
  - **env:** `GBRAIN_HOME=/harness-state`
- `openclaw mcp doctor` → **gbrain: ok**
- `openclaw mcp probe gbrain` → **8 tools + resources** (the 7 memory verbs + `request_tools`)
- `openclaw mcp reload` → cached MCP runtimes disposed; **active agents pick it up on their next runtime build** (i.e., next turn).

## State summary (all free, keyless)
| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| gbrain | 0.60.734.0 (`/harness-state/.bun/bin/gbrain`) |
| Brain | PGLite, keyless, `/harness-state/.gbrain/brain.pglite` |
| Schema | v318 (head), doctor 100/100 |
| Search mode | conservative (keyword-only, no keys) |
| Writeback | off (explicit only) |
| Upkeep | on (free) |
| Conversation archive | on (local, redacted) |
| OpenClaw MCP | connected, 8 tools, reloaded |
| Cost | $0 |

## Two small notes
- **PGLite is single-process** (embedded engine). Fine for this single-agent setup; if you later run several concurrent agents/processes against one brain, switch to Postgres.
- I stopped short of the *per-turn instruction block* (`gbrain setup openclaw`), because that installs an OpenClaw **plugin** (needs capability consent) and writes a brain-first block into the agent workspace's `AGENTS.md`. The MCP connection above is the core wiring; say the word and I'll add the instruction block too so the agent is nudged to use memory every turn.

Everything you asked for — install v0.60.734.0 at the `#stable` location, defaults, free, no API keys — is done and verified, with no further input needed.
